body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> iRobot presented its vacuum cleaning robot 'Roomba 610 Professional Series' at the CES 2009.
Designed to clean larger spaces and environments, the iRobot Roomba 610 Professional Series comes with two dust bins and a new 'Max Mode' feature for extra large messes.
The iRobot Roomba 610 Professional Series is priced at $549.99.
